name: bistable
title: Bistable genetic switch
question: Build a bistable genetic switch: two mutually repressing genes A and B that settle into two DISTINCT stable states and latch to whichever gene starts ahead (a decisive toggle, not a graded midpoint).
biological_summary: A process-bigraph Composite: a ToggleSwitch process — two mutually repressing genes A,B with COOPERATIVE (Hill n=2) repression. Cooperativity is the structural feature that destabilises the symmetric state and opens two stable basins, so the switch latches to whichever gene starts ahead.
conclusion:
## Final model
A process-bigraph Composite: a ToggleSwitch process — two mutually repressing genes A,B with COOPERATIVE (Hill n=2) repression. Cooperativity is the structural feature that destabilises the symmetric state and opens two stable basins, so the switch latches to whichever gene starts ahead.

## Result
DONE (2/2) in 1 edit — the LLM recognised that two stable states require COOPERATIVE feedback (Hill n≥2) and added it, opening two basins (state separation 3.46). The deterministic policy tuned expression (a knob), stayed monostable (separation 0), and gave up: bistability is a structural property no single knob tunes into being. See docs/bistable-agent-vs-policy.html.

findings.statement: Cooperative (Hill n=2) mutual repression between two genes A and B destabilises the symmetric fixed point and opens two distinct stable basins, so the composite settles into one of two decisive states rather than a graded midpoint. Confirmed: the agent-built ToggleSwitch reaches a state separation of 3.46 between the two basins, where the deterministic policy — which only tuned expression strength, a knob — stayed monostable at separation 0.

evidence.observed: state separation 3.46 between the two settled states (vs 0 for the monostable expression-tuning policy); behavior test 'bistable' == within_tol, gate passed

findings.statement: The switch latches to whichever gene starts ahead, resolving to a single dominant gene rather than relaxing to a symmetric midpoint — the decisive toggle the task requires. The same cooperative feedback makes this self-reinforcing: once one basin is entered it is held.

evidence.observed: the composite resolves to one dominant gene with no graded midpoint; behavior test 'decisive' == within_tol, gate passed
